_status: VERIFY — PLACEHOLDER SHAPE, NOT A CAPTURE (docs/VERIFY.md #9). No Tines page documents the body of a story-monitoring notification. Every key under `body` is an assumption, chosen only so that `normalize` and `classify_source` have something to be written against; they read it defensively with DEFAULT() over the candidate paths in `_normalize_reads`. Replace this whole file with a real, scrubbed capture before the router is trusted, then rewrite `normalize` and `classify_source` against it through /tines-build-story. Nothing in this file is a headline claim.
_capture_procedure: 1. In the DEV team (never 90 Seeds, never prod), build two scratch stories: a receiver with one Webhook action named `capture`, and a failer with one HTTP Request action to https://example.invalid/ (fails on DNS), emit failure event Always, retries 0.
2. On the failer: story-level 'Notify when any action fails' on; recipient = the `capture` webhook URL; run it LIVE once (monitoring is unavailable in TEST mode).
3. Run it again with the failure routed down a failure path to an Event Transform; record in `_captured.handled_failure_path_still_notified` whether a notification still arrived (docs/VERIFY.md #24).
4. Set 'Notify if no events emitted' on the failer's entry at the smallest value the UI accepts (minimum VERIFY) and wait for one no-events notification.
5. Copy each `capture` event body into `body` (failure) and `body_no_events` (no events). Scrub first — see `_scrub_before_commit`.
6. Repeat once per other Tines-origin sender and commit each as its own file: samples/ai-credit-alert.sample.json, samples/event-limit-alert.sample.json, samples/change-control.sample.json.

7. Record the outcome in docs/VERIFY.md (#9, #24); replace tests/sample-event.json with the scrubbed failure body; run /tines-build-story ops-error-router "Rewrite normalize and classify_source against samples/*.sample.json"; re-run the tests; delete both scratch stories.
_scrub_before_commit: story and action names -> the example names used below
any URL carrying a path, a secret or a query string -> removed, or reduced to https://<your-tenant>.tines.com/
any webhook path or secret -> removed
any log message text beyond the HTTP status -> shortened to a neutral phrase
_what_the_router_needs_from_a_capture: story id and name, action id, name and type, whether it is a failure or a no-events notification, a timestamp, and — if present — an HTTP status and a link. Anything else in the body is ignored and never posted.
_other_sources: The AI credit usage alert, the event-limit alert and the team change-control webhook are also undocumented (VERIFY #9) and get their own sample files once captured. The pipeline's own ship notification is the one known shape: scripts/ship_story.py posts {source: "ship_story.py", event, env, slug, story_id, draft_id, change_request_id, sha, source_url, run_url, requires} (see tests/expectations.yaml variant ci_change_request_opened).
